Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

Interface UserFileAccessService

public interface UserFileAccessService
Asynchronous access to one user-selected file through opaque, plugin-bound grants.

This service never exposes a filesystem path. Call request(UserFileRequest) first, then use only the returned UserFileHandle. Requesting a grant requires the chooser and matching read/write permissions; permission does not guarantee that a user-file provider is available. Completion results encode expected denial, cancellation, expiry, and I/O failures rather than exposing host or path details.

All operations are asynchronous. A UserFileLifetime.ONE_OPERATION handle expires after its first attempted operation; UserFileLifetime.UNTIL_DISABLE remains usable until revoked, closed, or plugin/runtime shutdown. Services and grants are closed through the plugin lifecycle, and callers may revoke a handle sooner.
